verdict.rationale: Expensify's own docs show you can generate dedicated API credentials (partnerUserID/partnerUserSecret) and rotate secrets. They also describe an OAuth2 authorization code flow that issues short-lived access tokens to act on behalf of individual users, which limits access per user and over time. However, nothing documents fine-grained permission scopes, read-only keys, or agent-specific restrictions. Missing for 10: explicit permission scopes or least-privilege controls on credentials, per-agent credential issuance, documentation of what a token can and cannot do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
